_README: holt's canaries: plaintext strings that must NOT appear verbatim in any shipped holt bundle (main/dist) or the partner loader (main/loader). Scanned by scripts/check-plaintext-leaks.mjs (vendored from abulxt), which hard-fails with exit 2 on a hit. This list lives in scripts/ so it is never emitted into the bundle. holt-owned: abulxt's list names abulxt's brands and domains. Keep it small; add a string only when it is a real literal rendered to users that holt commits to hiding. Since holt ships abulxt's chatbox (chatClient in vendor-manifest.json), it also carries abulxt's canaries (scripts/canary-list.json there), marked "abulxt:". Re-merge when abulxt adds one.
